entities.name: Ferenc Mező
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ferenc Mező, also known as Grünfeld, was a Hungarian poet. He was born in Pölöskefő, Zala County, and died in Budapest. In 1928, he won a gold medal in the art competitions of the Olympic Games for his "History of the Olympic Games".
